content.title: Lifecycle & Test Environments
content.content:
SnapLogic supports standard software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices with environment separation and automated promotion.

**Environment Structure:**

- **Development**: Dedicated SnapLogic Org for development work. Developers build and validate pipelines against non-production data sources. Ground Plex deployed in {{customer_name}}'s dev OpenShift namespace.
- **Test/UAT**: Separate Org for user acceptance testing. Pipelines promoted from Dev via slpkg CLI or Migration API. Ground Plex in test namespace with connectivity to test databases and APIs.
- **Production**: Production Org with restricted access (RBAC enforced). Pipelines promoted only after UAT sign-off. Ground Plex in production namespace with connectivity to live systems.

**Promotion Workflow:**

- Pipelines exported from Dev as JSON via `slpkg export` or Migration REST API
- JSON artefacts committed to {{customer_name}}'s GitLab repository for version control
- CI/CD pipeline (GitLab CI or Jenkins) promotes to Test/Prod using `slpkg import` — no manual Designer interaction
- Environment-specific configuration (connection credentials, file paths) parameterised via SnapLogic Pipeline Parameters
